title: Comfort Club Member Uplift on Labor Sublimits, Harbison Parts-and-Labor Protection Tiers
content:
On a claim against a Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor Protection, Harbison 12-Year Total Protection or Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus contract of Harbison Protection Contracts, the member sublimit is the tier's labor sublimit for the failed component multiplied by the member uplift. The member uplift is set by the holder's Comfort Club agreement, read from the holder's Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements record: its status, the member repair discount of its Comfort Club tier, and the number of consecutive terms held.

| Holder's Comfort Club agreement | Member uplift |
|---|---|
| in active status, at a tier whose member repair discount is at least 20% | 1.25 |
| in active status, at a lower tier (member repair discount below 20%), held for three or more consecutive terms | 1.10 |
| any other holder | 1 |

**Combinations.**

| Agreement in active status | Tier's member repair discount | Consecutive terms | Uplift |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | 20% or more | any | 1.25 |
| yes | below 20% | 3 or more | 1.10 |
| yes | below 20% | 1 or 2 | 1 |
| no agreement in active status | — | — | 1 |

**Thresholds on both sides.** A member repair discount of exactly 20% takes 1.25; 19% takes the loyal-member test. Three consecutive terms meet the loyal-member test; two do not.

**Components without a sublimit.** A component with no labor sublimit has nothing to raise; its labor is not capped by a sublimit.

**Worked figure (hypothetical; the $1400.00 sublimit is illustrative).** A compressor claim with an illustrative compressor labor sublimit of $1400.00, holder in an active agreement at a tier with a 20% member repair discount: member sublimit $1400.00 multiplied by 1.25, that is $1750.00. Holder at a 10% tier in a fourth consecutive term: $1400.00 multiplied by 1.10, that is $1540.00.
